variants.name: deeper fan set-back and rear valley
variants.why: R01.3 and R01.4 (critic issues 1 and 3, spec rules): the spec asks the fan front to sit at least .015 fig behind the dome at |x| .07 and the rear valley crest-minus-valley at least .018; current front_set_back is .05 local (.013 fig) and rear_valley .05. Neither depth was ever raised in a kept or reverted round (rounds 19 and 29 only touched the crown). Edited at H25, the last R01 step.
